tools.name: convert_to_markdown
tools.description:
Convert PDF and image files to clean Markdown for RAG, LLM ingestion, and knowledge bases. Optionally include MinerU layout JSON (content list with blocks and bounding boxes).

Input: 1-5 public https file URLs, each ≤20 MiB. Supported: pdf, png, jpeg, webp, bmp, tiff. DOCX is not supported in this

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description:
Extract text from images, screenshots, and scanned PDF pages. Returns text blocks with block-level bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] and page indexes. Coordinates are MinerU content-list coordinates, not character-level boxes and not rescaled to pixels.

Input: 1-5 public https file URLs, each ≤20 MiB

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description:
Extract tables from PDFs and images as HTML plus a row/column matrix. Merged cells are expanded; only the top-left cell carries content and other covered cells are empty strings. Returns row_count, column_count, page_idx, and bbox for each table.

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translate up to 50,000 characters of plain text (up to 50 strings). Long inputs are split into <=1,900-character chunks automatically. Synchronous. Cost: 1 credit per call; mcp-credit-gateway charges before forwarding the request. Requires Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... on the MCP endpoint.

tools.name: translate_document
tools.description: Translate a document from a public URL. Supported formats include PDF, DOCX/DOC, XLSX/XLS, PPTX/PPT, EPUB, TXT, HTML, MD and CSV. Upstream size limits: PDF <= 30 MB, other formats <= 80 MB. This is an async job: the call waits up to wait_seconds (default 30, max 120) and returns a job_id if still ru

tools.name: translate_image
tools.description: Translate text inside 1-10 images supplied as public URLs (JPG/PNG/WebP recommended; keep each image <= 10 MB). This is an async job: the call waits up to wait_seconds (default 30, max 120) and returns a job_id if still running. Call again with the same job_id to poll; polling does not start a new t

tools.name: translate_subtitle
tools.description: Translate SRT, WebVTT or ASS/SSA subtitle content (up to 1,000,000 characters). Timestamps, cue order, SRT/VTT indices and ASS event fields are preserved exactly; only cue text is translated. Synchronous. Cost: 3 credits per call, charged by mcp-credit-gateway before forwarding the request.

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the language of up to 20,000 characters. Uses a local Unicode-script + stopword/diacritic heuristic; no upstream call. Returns a language code, confidence, reliability flag and alternatives. Billing: free by default (COST_DETECT_LANGUAGE=0).

tools.name: add_watermark
tools.description: Add a visible text or image watermark to an image or PDF supplied as a public URL. Formats: JPG/PNG/WebP images up to 10 MB; PDF up to 30 MB. watermark_type=text requires `text` (<= 500 chars); watermark_type=image requires `watermark_image_url` (PNG/JPG/WebP, <= 5 MB, transparency supported). Posit

tools.name: remove_watermark
tools.description: AI watermark removal / inpainting for ONE image (JPG/PNG/WebP, <= 10 MB) supplied as a public URL. Optional `mask_image_url` (white = remove) or normalized `mask_rect` {x,y,width,height} in 0-1; with neither, the upstream auto-detect mode is used (support depends on the upstream). COPYRIGHT / ABUSE
